correctness.rationale: The exact periodized resolvent expansion for c_{n,j}(h) with a=h/(h+2), b=h/(h+1) was reconstructed and the integer numerators for n=2..5 independently calculated: all are coefficient-positive except (5,4), whose numerator is four times p(h)=25h^8+300h^7+1300h^6+2850h^5+3450h^4+2240h^3+560h^2-160h-96. Descartes plus exact rational endpoint signs give its unique positive recovery root. For every n>=5, the coefficient of P^4 in the stability series is (2*5/16-1)h^4=-3h^4/8; for each fixed finite n, Fourier diagonalization gives T_n(h) tending to the strictly positive uniform projection as h→infinity. Mass conservation follows from Q1=0. This proves the infinite n conclusion rather than only checking finite samples.
